headline: North-West revenue slid ₹90K/day mostly from late deliveries and lost enterprise accounts.
body: Our region drove nearly the whole revenue drop this month. The warehouse backlog and missed delivery windows pushed customers to complain and enterprise buyers to pause orders [E1]. Meridian Retail actually moved their replenishment business to a competitor after repeated SLA misses [E2]. Kalinga Mart's renewal is now at risk for the same reason [E4].

actions.action: Add overflow capacity at WH-07 to clear backlog
actions.expected_impact: Restore on-time delivery and stop further account loss
actions.monitoring: Daily SLA % and backlog count at WH-07

actions.action: Offer Kalinga Mart an SLA guarantee to save renewal

what_could_change: If SLA recovers and complaints drop but revenue stays low, look harder at marketing conversion.
caveats: Marketing conversion decline is unexplained and could be adding to the loss independently.
